warning.titlePre: Jaguar XE D150 Timing Chain & Injector Seal Wear
paragraphs: If your XE D150 is a pre-2020 model with the Ingenium AJ200D diesel — that's the X760 generation — timing chain and injector seal wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine, widely corroborated across JLR specialist forums and independent garages. We replace the timing chain, tensioners and injector seals as standard on every AJ200D rebuild.
The petrol variants in the XE range — the P200, P250 and P300 — use a different engine, the Ingenium AJ200P, which doesn't share this specific diesel timing chain issue.
warning.source: Source: widely corroborated across JLR specialist forums and independent garages (per G-BRF), per VRF-jaguar-xe.md. Petrol Ingenium AJ200P explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF.
